text:
marta_ops: Quick sync — EU provisioning gap: 24 h200s stuck at customs in FRA. Dock flagged 6 units with serial mismatches; vendor flagged possible SKU swap. Need immediate RMA routing + options for temporary capacity to avoid customer impact.

sam_sre: :eyes: do we have AWB / customs doc? any photos of packaging/labels?

leo_supply: Vendor shared AWB and photos in the portal, but customs rejected 6 serials due to manifest mismatch. Remaining 18 cleared.

ana_sales: heads-up from product: two customers in EU will hit hard if we lose more than 4 units in the next 48h. Can we borrow units from another region?

vendor_acme: we pulled the shipment manifest — AWB `ACME-1748-FRA`. Cause seems to be a pick error at source; we can do an RMA partial replace or a crossdock to swap corrected SKUs. Air expedite ETA ~72h, ground rework ~6 days.

marta_ops: Costs? expedited air vs crossdock? and what's the vendor SLA on bulk replace?

vendor_acme: Air expedite add-on €4,200 per trunk (covers customs clearance priority + express AWB). Crossdock rework absorbed by vendor if we accept depot repair flow (vendor covers labor but not uplift freight). Replace SLA: 7 business days for full replace, 3 business days for expedited partial.

leo_supply: If vendor covers depot labor, we still need depot availability and a secure manifest for serial updates. Depot queue is 48h today.

sam_sre: Operational note — if we route replaced units via our FR-DE edge pool we can avoid re-keying into EU contracts, but network handoff needs VPN cert refresh (ops can do on schedule).

vendor_acme: we can split the RMA: ship 6 corrected SKUs immediate air (expedite), and re-issue manifest for the rest. We'll provide new AWBs and manifest CSV.

depot_bot: Ticket DEP-8342 created for FRA depot intake (eta 48h). Attach photos + vendor CN23 to avoid secondary hold.

marta_ops: Good. Two asks: (1) vendor to confirm final AWB + manifest CSV by EOD CET; (2) sam/leo to validate whether we can borrow 2 units from DE pool for immediate customer needs and track cross-region cost.

ana_sales: noted — I'll flag customers and push potential maintenance window if we need to swap units.

leo_supply: Quick calc: if we borrow 2 units from DE, we'll pay inter-region transfer fee ~€150 per unit plus VAT. If we expedite 6 by air from vendor it's ~€700 per unit all-in vs crossdock ~€120/unit but 5-6 day delay.

sam_sre: For borrow flow we need to update routing rules to prefer FR->DE fallback for these tenant tags — I can push a short-lived override and revert after 72h. Will log change.

vendor_acme: AWB for expedited tranche: `ACME-1748-EXP1`. Manifest CSV link: https://acme.example.com/manifests/ACME-1748-EXP1.csv — includes corrected serials.

marta_ops: Please attach photos in thread and confirm vendor will absorb depot labor for crossdock. Also vendor — do you accept our standard RMA EDI (we need `rma_id` on manifest)?

vendor_acme: Confirmed on depot labor and EDI `rma_id` support. We'll include `rma_id` in the CSV and send signed commercial invoice to speed customs.

depot_bot: DEP-8342 updated with AWB `ACME-1748-EXP1`. Intake slot provisionally booked for 48h from now.

leo_supply: I'll take borrow from DE for 2 units now and mark them as temporary loaners; cost center: infra-eu-emergency.

sam_sre: Override pushed for FR->DE fallback routing. Change ID `route-override-8821`. Revert scheduled +72h.

marta_ops: Plan recap: vendor sends 6 corrected units via `ACME-1748-EXP1` (ETA ~72h). We borrow 2 from DE pool to cover immediate SLAs. Depot will intake and reconcile serials, vendor covers depot labor; vendor will provide `rma_id` in manifest. Finance: expect a small inter-region transfer fee + expedite uplift.

ana_sales: I'll message impacted customers with a tentative 72h fix and offer credits if breach occurs.

vendor_acme: We'll start the AWB handoff and report customs clearance updates hourly until landed.

marta_ops: Thanks — please post customs clearance and final manifest here once landed. If anything changes escalate to #incidents. :pray:
